long_description:
The Great Bridal Expo in San Jose is a premier event for couples planning their dream weddings. Set in the picturesque Hayes Mansion, part of the Curio Collection by Hilton, this expo invites attendees to explore a wide array of wedding services and products all under one roof. Scheduled for November 22, 2026, the event promises to be a day filled with inspiration, showcasing the latest trends in bridal fashion, floral arrangements, catering options, and much more. Couples will have the unique opportunity to meet with top wedding vendors, attend informative seminars, and participate in exciting giveaways. 

Also check out other Business events in San Jose, Exhibitions in San Jose, Workshops in San Jose.
